landing.faq_0_q: Do I need to install anything?
landing.faq_0_a: No. The system is fully web-based – open your browser and sign in from any device.
landing.faq_1_q: Can I manage multiple restaurant locations?
landing.faq_1_a: Yes. All plans support multiple restaurants under a single admin account.
landing.faq_2_q: How many staff accounts can I add?
landing.faq_2_a: There is no limit on the number of staff accounts.
landing.faq_3_a: Yes — you can try any plan (Basic, Advanced, Premium) free for 30 days. No credit card required. You can switch between plans freely during your trial.
landing.faq_4_q: Can I switch plans during the trial period?
landing.faq_4_a: Yes, with no restrictions and no payment required. Simply select a different plan in your billing settings and the change takes effect immediately.
landing.faq_5_q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
landing.faq_5_a: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time in your billing settings.
landing.faq_6_q: Do you offer annual billing by invoice?
landing.faq_6_a: Yes. Get in touch with us and we'll arrange annual payment by bank transfer / proforma invoice.
landing.faq_7_q: What payment methods do you accept?
landing.faq_7_a: Credit and debit cards via Stripe. Annual plans can also be paid by invoice.
landing.faq_8_a: Data is isolated per account. Passwords are hashed (bcrypt). Sessions expire after inactivity. HTTPS is required.
landing.faq_9_q: What is the public reservation link?
landing.faq_9_a: A unique URL that guests visit to book a table directly — no phone calls required. Available on the Advanced and Premium plans.
landing.faq_10_q: Can I embed a reservation form on my website?
landing.faq_10_a: Yes, on the Premium plan. A short JavaScript snippet lets you embed the reservation form directly on any website.

landing_aff.hero_subtitle: Share your unique link, and we handle onboarding, payments, and support. You receive commission for {months} months on every paid subscription.

landing_aff.audience_1_desc: Do you help restaurants with digitalisation, marketing, or operations? Add Rezble to your offering and earn a commission with every referral.

landing_aff.how_step2_desc: Every affiliate gets a unique link and ref code. A 60-day cookie handles the tracking.
landing_aff.how_step3_desc: Once the referred restaurant makes its first subscription payment, {pct}% commission moves into hold for you.
landing_aff.how_step4_desc: After {hold} days, the commission becomes payable. Payouts via IBAN once you reach €{minPayout}.

landing_aff.perks_title: What You Get as an Affiliate
landing_aff.perks_subtitle: All the tools you need to refer successfully – no technical headaches.
landing_aff.perks_links_desc: Your unique referral link, a built-in UTM generator (source / medium / campaign), and a printable QR code – all in your dashboard.
landing_aff.perks_dashboard_desc: Clicks (30 days), sign-ups, active paying subscribers, total earned, and payable balance – live stats.
landing_aff.perks_tracking_desc: Cookie attribution (last click) with a 60-day window. At sign-up, tracking is tied to the user – no corrections needed.
landing_aff.perks_material_desc: Ready-made templates for social media and email – copy and paste directly from your dashboard.
landing_aff.perks_payout_desc: Once your payable balance reaches €{min}, we transfer it to your IBAN. No sales quotas, no hidden fees.
landing_aff.perks_support_desc: Your affiliate manager is reachable by email. Questions about tracking or payouts are resolved within 24h.
landing_aff.faq_0_q: How much does it cost to join the program?
landing_aff.faq_0_a: Nothing. Signing up and using the affiliate dashboard is completely free. We pay you – when the restaurant you referred pays their subscription.
landing_aff.faq_1_a: Every affiliate gets a unique ref code (e.g. ?ref=AB7K9X2P). When a visitor clicks your link, we set a cookie valid for 60 days. If they sign up within that period, you are credited as the source.
landing_aff.faq_2_q: When do I receive my commission?
landing_aff.faq_2_a: Commission is generated when the referred restaurant makes its first subscription payment. After a {hold}-day hold (protection against refunds), it becomes "payable". We process the payout once you reach €{min}.
landing_aff.faq_3_q: How long do I earn commission for the same restaurant?
landing_aff.faq_3_a: You receive {pct}% commission for {months} months from the restaurant's first payment. After that, no further commission is earned, even if the restaurant continues to pay.
landing_aff.faq_4_q: Who is eligible for the affiliate program?
landing_aff.faq_4_a: Anyone who works with restaurant owners or creates content about the food and hospitality industry – agencies, consultants, bloggers, YouTubers, local food communities. Individuals with friends in hospitality are welcome too.
landing_aff.faq_5_q: Can I refer my own account?
landing_aff.faq_5_a: No. Self-referrals are blocked – the system rejects the commission attribution if the affiliate email matches the registered restaurant's email or if they share the same tax number. No commission is generated for self-referral attempts.
landing_aff.faq_6_a: Commission is taxable income. How it's handled depends on your legal form (individual, sole trader, company) — enter your form during registration so we can issue the correct documentation.
landing_aff.faq_7_q: How do I dispute a missing conversion?
landing_aff.faq_7_a: Email our affiliate manager with the click timestamp and the content you shared. We'll review the system logs and manually attribute the commission if needed. You'll hear back within 5 business days.
landing_aff.cta_title: Ready to earn your first commission?
landing_aff.cta_subtitle: Sign-up takes 2 minutes. Review in 1–2 days. Your first click could happen tonight.
landing_aff.footer_tagline: Rezble Affiliate Program – share Rezble with the world and earn {pct}% commission for every restaurant you refer.

aff.terms.title: Affiliate Program Terms
aff.terms.p_general: By joining the {app} affiliate program, you agree to these terms. The program is designed to promote the {app} platform and reward partners for successfully referring new paying customers.
aff.terms.p_eligibility: You may participate in the program if:
aff.terms.li_eligibility_1: You are an adult individual or legal entity based in the EU.
aff.terms.li_eligibility_2: You have valid banking details (IBAN) for payouts.
aff.terms.li_eligibility_3: Your application has been reviewed and approved by an administrator.
aff.terms.p_attribution: Each partner receives a unique referral code. When a visitor clicks your link, a tracking cookie valid for 60 days is placed in their browser. Attribution follows the last-click model (last click wins).
aff.terms.p_commission_1: Commission is earned for every successful payment made by a referred customer within a 12-month window from their first registration. The commission rate is set upon approval and is shown in your dashboard. Payouts are available after a 45-day holding period.
aff.terms.li_no_commission_3: Payments made after the 12-month window has elapsed.
aff.terms.p_payouts: Payouts are processed manually in batches (SEPA bank transfer). The minimum payout amount is defined in the programme settings. You must have valid banking details (IBAN) on file to receive a payout.
aff.terms.p_discount: An administrator may assign you a personal discount code to share with referred customers. The code must not be distributed in mass email campaigns without prior consent. The code may be deactivated without notice in the event of misuse.
aff.terms.li_prohibited_1: Misleading claims, false statements, or spam on behalf of {app}.
aff.terms.li_prohibited_2: Buying clicks or running paid ads using our brand without prior consent.
aff.terms.li_prohibited_3: Self-referrals or artificially inflating your stats.
aff.terms.li_prohibited_4: Sharing discount codes on coupon aggregator sites.
aff.terms.p_termination: {app} reserves the right to terminate your participation without prior notice in the event of a terms violation. In such cases, any unpaid commissions that have not yet reached ‘payable’ status will be forfeited.
aff.terms.p_privacy: We process your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection legislation and the GDPR. For payment purposes, we retain your IBAN and tax identification number.
aff.terms.p_changes: We may update these terms at any time. We will notify you of any material changes by email. Continued participation after receiving such notice constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
landing_aff.calc_disclaimer_yearly: With an annual subscription, the customer pays once a year — within the {months}-month window you receive one commission per restaurant. Actual amount depends on paying customers and retention.
